# GL Trading Company - Comprehensive Overview

## About Us
GL Trading Company is a premier supplier of high-quality paper and board products. We bridge the gap between traditional industrial operations and modern digital efficiency, bringing over 80 years of heritage and trust to the B2B paper trading market in India. Our foundation is built on steadfast trust, client relationships, and punctuality.

## Our Legacy & Founders

### Late Shri Govindlal ji Kabra - The Foundation (1940)
In 1940, starting with ambition and vision, Late Shri Govindlal ji Kabra established a cloth business in Indore. His hard work and principles established the bedrock of our 80+ year legacy.

### Mr. Rajesh Kabra - Diversification (1976)
In 1976, Mr. Rajesh Kabra diversified the business from cloth to the emerging market of the paper industry. With his vision and relationships, the company set new benchmarks and successfully achieved tremendous growth in the paper trade.

### Mr. Vedant Kabra - Modern Era (1999)
Joining in 1999, Mr. Vedant Kabra (Current Founder & Managing Director) learned from his father and grandfather. In 2016, he officially established GL Trading Company as a separate entity, transforming the enterprise into a tech-enabled, multi-grade paper supplier.

## Products & Solutions

### Kraft Paper Solutions
We provide durable and sustainable Kraft Paper solutions tailored for diverse packaging needs. Our Kraft Paper is known for its strength, reliability, and commitment to circular packaging.

### Box Board Solutions
Our premium Box Board materials, including Folding Box Board (FBB), are ideal for rigid packaging and high-end boxes. They are supplied to meet rigorous quality standards for superior printing and structural integrity.

### Duplex Board
We supply high-grade Duplex Board for reliable structural packaging, supporting a variety of industrial and commercial applications.

### Copier Paper Solutions
We provide high-quality A3 and A4 Copier Paper (70-100 GSM) designed for office and commercial use, ensuring excellent print quality and smooth performance in standard copiers and printers.

## Sustainability & Circular Economy
We are committed to 100% circular packaging and sustainability, ensuring our products contribute to an eco-friendly supply chain without compromising on industrial strength and quality.
